name: InteliAds
subtitle: KDP royalties & Amazon Ads profit
promotional_text: See net royalties minus ad spend, spot campaign leaks, and get daily performance alerts — built for KDP authors.
description:
InteliAds is the profit dashboard for Kindle Direct Publishing authors who run Amazon Ads.

See what you actually keep:
• Net royalties minus ad spend at a glance
• Month and week views with daily chart scrubbing
• ACoS, spend, orders, and margin in one place

Fix leaks faster:
• Campaign leak detection and top spenders
• Book-level net royalties when KDP is linked
• Targeting and keyword visibility on iPhone

Stay informed:
• Daily performance notifications with spend, orders, and ACoS
• Optional KDP net in the same alert
• Background refresh when iOS wakes the app

InteliAds connects to your InteliAds account. KDP royalties sync via the InteliAds Chrome helper at inteliads.io — this app does not collect KDP credentials on iPhone.

Built for authors, not agencies. Clear numbers. No guesswork.
